subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Now people walk there in the evening, watching the river below.”?
options: Sometimes usefulness changes with time, but it does not always disappear.
Sometimes a place changes not because it becomes larger or newer, but because it gives people time to stop.
Sometimes the best answer depends on time, purpose, and compromise.
Sometimes losing one small comfort helps people find other ways to use time.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Now people walk there in the evening, watching the river below. Sometimes usefulness changes with time, but it does not always disappear.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes a place changes not because it becomes larger or newer, but because it gives people time to…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes the best answer depends on time, purpose, and compromise.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes losing one small comfort helps people find other ways to use time.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Now people walk there in the evening, watching the river below. Sometimes usefulness changes with time, but it does not always disappear.」，答案為「Sometimes usefulness changes with time, but it does not always disappear.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Sometimes usefulness changes with time, but it does not always disappear.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
